nodes.label: Campus Domain Lock (@vitstudent.ac.in)
nodes.rationale: Student sign-in is locked to the @vitstudent.ac.in domain (case-insensitive, exact suffix). TODO in source: enforce server-side with a Firebase blocking function once on the Blaze plan, because a modified client could bypass this client-side check.

nodes.label: Firestore Profile as Role Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: The Firestore users document is the source of truth for the user's role: on existing profiles the stored role wins over whatever the login toggle said, and the client must never write any role other than 'student'.
nodes.norm_label: firestore profile as role source of truth

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Auth Error Handling
nodes.rationale: Do not fake a role or route the user when the profile cannot be loaded - surface it as a retryable ProfileUnavailable error state instead.

nodes.label: Cumulative Leg-Duration ETA Computation
nodes.rationale: Stop ETAs are derived from a single Directions request with departure_time=now: per-leg duration_in_traffic (falling back to duration) values are summed cumulatively so each stop's ETA reflects travel through all preceding stops.

nodes.label: Role-Based Auth Guard (no deep links, back stack cleared on role change so cross-role navigation is impossible)
nodes.norm_label: role-based auth guard (no deep links, back stack cleared on role change so cross-role navigation is impossible)

nodes.label: THRESHOLD_MAP (distance-to-minutes thresholds)
nodes.rationale: Thresholds approximate how far a shuttle is at campus speeds (~15-20 km/h): 10 min -> 2500 m, 5 min -> 1200 m, 2 min -> 500 m.

nodes.norm_label: phase 4: role-based auth + navigation + driver privacy

nodes.norm_label: google sign-in, role routing, sign-out implementation plan

nodes.label: FCM Topic Convention stop_{stopId}_{threshold}min
nodes.rationale: Topics encode stop + arrival threshold so students subscribe per alert level (10/5/2 min) without the backend tracking per-device tokens; Cloud Function broadcasts geofenced pushes to matching topics.

nodes.label: Firebase RTDB /shuttles/{shuttleId} telemetry stream
nodes.rationale: RTDB chosen for sub-second GPS location streaming (driver writes every 5s); same path feeds student map rendering and triggers the proximity Cloud Function.

nodes.label: Firestore stops collection
nodes.rationale: Static stop definitions (name, lat/lng, order) stored in Firestore and read by the Cloud Function for distance evaluation.

nodes.label: Firestore seatAvailability/{shuttleId} collection
nodes.rationale: Driver seat counter writes live counts here; the Cloud Function reads it to enrich push messages ('N seats left') and the student map streams it for the seat meter.

nodes.label: 5-Minute On-Duty Staleness Guard
nodes.rationale: Locations older than 5 minutes are filtered out of the student map as a secondary privacy guard so off-duty drivers never remain visible even if a stale RTDB node lingers.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture + MVI/MVVM (Unidirectional Data Flow)
nodes.rationale: Domain/Data/Presentation layering with ViewModels exposing StateFlow was chosen for separation of concerns and unidirectional data flow across the app.

nodes.label: Duty Switch Privacy Guarantee
nodes.rationale: Off-duty must guarantee complete location privacy: stopping the foreground service kills GPS writes entirely; no coordinates are ever written when off-duty.

nodes.label: Institutional Domain Lock (@vitstudent.ac.in)
nodes.rationale: STUDENT role requires email ending with @vitstudent.ac.in (rejected otherwise with DomainRestrictionException); DRIVER accepts any email. Enforces the campus-only user base at sign-in time.
